text:
Olivia (CS): FYI — we just saw a delayed webhook batch during overnight onboarding runs that left ~18 tenants with stalled connector steps. some customers hit retries and timeouts, others saw partial provisioning. I'm compiling the impacted list: https://redwood.share/inc/1723456789 :eyes:

SupportBot: INCIDENT-2026-1984 | Severity: P3 | Impacts: onboarding webhook delays to ~18 tenants | Notified oncall

Rafael (Onboard): rough split: 10 SMB, 8 mid-market. 5 are flagged as high-touch (close to go-live) and 3 are renewal-schedule in next 30 days. renewal risk if not handled quickly.

Olivia (CS): comms needs: 1) immediate status ping to impacted contacts in local language where possible; 2) schedule expedited 1:1 onboarding calls (offer blocking calendar links); 3) propose a small goodwill package (1 week credits + 2 free concierge hours) for the high-touch ones. want AMs in the loop before outbound.

Ava (AM): please add me to the high-touch list. I'll coordinate account-specific messaging and pricing concessions if any. also want to attach a short executive note for larger accounts.

Nina (Eng): root cause appears to be a transient queue delay after a third-party rate limiter throttled webhook delivery. we rerouted retries and processed the backlog at 02:45 UTC. added a resiliency patch and raised retry window. we'll provide a succinct RCA paragraph for customer follow-up.

Jules (Legal): the goodwill offer is fine. keep the language factual and avoid statements about SLA breaches. I can quick-review the templated messages.

Olivia (CS): draft status message (short):

"Hi <Name>,

We noticed a delay affecting automated provisioning steps for your onboarding flow last night. Our team has processed the backlog and services are functioning normally. We're sorry for any interruption. To help, we'd like to offer 2 hours of hands-on concierge support and 7 days of credits; if you'd like a 1:1 session we'll prioritize scheduling.

— Olivia, Customer Success"

Rafael (Onboard): Two asks: can we include a small troubleshooting snippet for customers who want to self-check? like: `Check connector status -> restart sync -> confirm items processed`

Nina (Eng): added a short checklist in the incident doc: `view logs -> re-trigger webhook -> confirm processed_count > 0`

Olivia (CS): also want the outbound to include translated lines for Spanish and French contacts. Kai (RevOps) — can you surface localized contact lists?

Kai (RevOps): yes — I'll pull localized contact emails and timezones. will add translated salutations and subject lines.

Ava (AM): for enterprise accounts, please use this exec blurb: "Our engineering team processed the backlog and implemented a protective retry enhancement. We'll follow up with you personally to ensure your launch timeline is unaffected."

Jules (Legal): tweak: replace "protective" with "additional". small wording change to avoid implying previous safeguards were insufficient.

Olivia (CS): action items:
- send localized status pings to all impacted within 90 mins (owner: Olivia)
- schedule concierge sessions for replies and high-touch accounts (owner: Rafael)
- AM outreach for the 3 renewal-schedule accounts (owner: Ava)
- legal review of all templates (owner: Jules)
- RevOps to provide localized lists and timezone-aware send windows (owner: Kai)
- Eng to paste a 2-sentence RCA for customers (owner: Nina)

SupportBot: tickets created: 18 (label: incident-1723456789). please attach outcome notes to each ticket.

Olivia (CS): we should capture sentiment after calls. short survey: "Was the issue resolved to your satisfaction? (yes/no)" + optional "How likely are you to renew? 1-5". Rafael — can your schedulers include the survey link?

Rafael (Onboard): yes. I'll add the survey to the post-call email and flag responses >3 for AM follow-up.

Nina (Eng): postmortem plan: will publish a one-page RCA in 48 hours and include mitigations (retry window, rate-limit backoff). linking to incident doc once ready.

Ava (AM): for any account that indicates reduced renewal likelihood, let's offer an additional month credit + a focused migration playbook session. I'll coordinate approvals with finance if needed.

Olivia (CS): thanks team. I'll paste the localized subject lines and the Spanish/French snippets here in 20 and start sending. will report back after first 8 outreach attempts. :white_check_mark:
